entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is 78-Delta-Charlie-2.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Series cycling shoes. Is that the item?

I understand you want to start a return. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
They don't work. I wore them for one ride and they gave me blisters. I just want my money back.

I'm sorry to hear they were uncomfortable. Blisters are definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Sometimes adjusting the position of the cleats can make a significant difference in comfort and prevent pressure points. Did you have a chance to try that?
Understood. Not a problem at all. I see here you received the cycling shoes just two days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window. I can process that full refund for you right away.

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
